analyst_note: All 26 SEVERE and MODERATE refuted findings concern programs other than the catalyst: NSCLC (CAN-2409), pancreatic cancer (CAN-2409), or glioblastoma (CAN-3110). The catalyst is a Phase 3 randomized, controlled trial of CAN-2409 in localized prostate cancer (NCT01436968). Under principle #2, trial-specific findings (efficacy overreach, biomarker leaps, cross-trial comparisons) only count if they describe the catalyst trial itself. None do. The five MINOR timeline findings note a decade of slippage on the prostate Phase 3, but the company's Q4 2024 guidance filed as late as November 2024 matches the registered December 2024 primary completion date—this reflects slow accrual disclosed in the registry, not active concealment of a pending miss. No company-level fraud findings (principle #1) were flagged. The marketing is consistent with an honest sponsor promoting early-stage data in other indications while the pivotal prostate trial reads out on its registered timeline.
